The bug is on line 19: `total = int(value) * _UNITS[unit]` overwrites `total` instead of adding to it. Should be `total += int(value) * _UNITS[unit]`.











Now add tests for combined durations:





















All 6 tests pass.

The fix was a one-character change: `total =` → `total +=` on line 19 of `durations/__init__.py`. The loop was overwriting `total` on each iteration instead of accumulating, so combined durations like `"1h30m"` only kept the last part. Two new tests covering combined `hours+minutes` and `hours+minutes+seconds` were added.
